title: 第1746章 电闪雷鸣第1745章 你以为这样你就安全了
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
一道道紫色雷电，宛如紫色狂潮，向着楚天铭呼啸冲击而来。
“哼，想要杀我，可没有那么简单。”
楚天铭冷哼一声，右脚猛地一踏，而后毫无顾忌的冲向了那紫电狂潮。
滋啦啦！
那些紫色电蛇，不断轰击楚天铭的身躯。
然而楚天铭的身体四周，却是有一道白色光盾，这光盾彷佛是绝缘体一般，将所有的紫色电蛇全部隔绝开来。
楚天铭脚踏在这紫色狂潮之上，竟然丝毫不受影响，以极快的速度，向着紫霄雷尊冲了过来。
“怎么会？你这家伙竟然不怕我的紫霄雷霆？”紫霄雷尊满脸不可置信的表情。
“哼，能够吸收紫霄雷霆之力的人，可不止你一个！”
楚天铭嘴角一扬，虽然没有六道轮回眼，但是他的轮回元力，可是蕴含着九种属性，而雷属性也是其中之一，所以这紫霄雷霆之力，对别人来说的确是巨大的威胁，但是对他而言，并非无法对抗。
“将死之人，何必多问！”
楚天铭冷笑一声，瞬间出现在了紫霄雷尊的面前，而后右手缓缓抬起，两根手指，向着紫霄雷尊的眼睛指了过去。
“狂妄！”
紫霄雷尊回过神来，怒哼一声，双手抬起，那紫电狂龙疯狂甩动身躯，试图将楚天铭甩飞出去。
然而楚天铭的双脚，却是如同吸盘一般，牢牢的吸附在紫电狂龙的身躯之上，并且迅速向着紫霄雷尊逼近。
“找死！”
紫霄雷尊见此，眼神陡然一寒，双手迅速结印，密密麻麻的紫色光柱，向着楚天铭轰来。
“我说了，你的雷霆之力，对我毫无用处！”
楚天铭冷哼一声，袖子轻轻一挥，虚空旋涡出现在了他的身后方，直接将所有的雷霆光柱，全部吞噬了进去。
“死瞎子，就算没有雷霆之力，我一样可以打死你！”

紫霄雷尊怒喝一声，身躯之上，雷霆环绕，整个人瞬间化作一道雷电光柱，猛地向着楚天铭撞击而来。
这道闪电速度快到了极致，转瞬之间，便出现在了楚天铭的面前。
“给老子去死！”
紫霄雷尊的拳头之上，萦绕着恐怖的紫色雷光，然后猛地向着楚天铭砸了过来。
这一拳充斥着狂暴至极的力量，即便其蕴含的雷霆之力，对楚天铭无法造成伤害，但是其恐怖的力量，楚天铭也是不敢小觑。
楚天铭双臂立刻交叉在一起，身上金光涌动，一道金色护盾出现在了前方。
轰隆！
这一拳结结实实的砸在了护盾之上，恐怖的雷霆之力，瞬间将护盾撞开，并且重重的撞在了楚天铭的双臂之上。
巨力传来，楚天铭顿觉双臂一麻，身体不受控制的向后倒退出去。
连退了数十里，才将那股巨大的力量，勉强的抵御了下来。
然而还没等楚天铭站稳脚跟，那紫霄雷尊就再次化身一道闪电，再次冲到了楚天铭的面前。
“这家伙的力量惊人，与其硬拼，绝对不是其对手，不如先消耗一下他体内的元力。”
楚天铭目光一闪，脚踏虚空，身形迅速消失在了原地，避开了紫霄雷尊的一击。
content_en:
Purple thunder and lightning, like a purple frenzy, roared towards Chu Tianming.
"Hmph, it's not that simple to kill me."
Chu Tianming snorted coldly, stepped hard with his right foot, and then rushed towards the purple lightning frenzy without any scruples.
Zi La La!
Those purple electric snakes kept bombarding Chu Tianming's body.
However, there was a white light shield surrounding Chu Tianming's body. This light shield seemed to be an insulator, isolating all the purple electric snakes.
Chu Tianming stepped on this purple craze and was not affected at all. He rushed towards Zixiao Lei Zun at an extremely fast speed.
"How could it be? You guys are not afraid of my Zixiao Thunder?" Zixiao Lei Zun had an expression of disbelief on his face.
"Hmph, you are not the only one who can absorb the power of Zixiao's thunder!"
Chu Tianming raised his lips. Although he did not have the Six Paths of Samsara Eye, his Samsara Yuan Power contained nine attributes, and the thunder attribute was one of them. Therefore, the power of Zixiao Thunder was indeed a huge threat to others, but it was not impossible for him to fight against it.
"Why bother asking a dying man!"
Chu Tianming sneered and appeared in front of Zixiao Leizun in an instant. Then he slowly raised his right hand and pointed two fingers towards Zixiao Leizun's eyes.
"Arrogant!"
Zixiao Lei Zun came back to his senses, roared angrily, raised his hands, and the purple electric dragon swung its body wildly, trying to throw Chu Tianming away.
However, Chu Tianming's feet were like suckers, firmly attached to the body of the Purple Lightning Crazy Dragon, and quickly approached the Zixiao Lei Zun.
"Seeking death!"
Seeing this, Zixiao Lei Zun's eyes suddenly turned cold, he quickly formed seals with his hands, and dense purple beams of light blasted towards Chu Tianming.
"I told you, your thunder power is of no use to me!"
Chu Tianming snorted coldly, waved his sleeves slightly, and the void vortex appeared behind him, swallowing all the thunder beams directly.
"You blind man, even if I don't have the power of thunder, I can still beat you to death!"
Zixiao Lei Zun roared angrily, thunder surrounded his body, and his whole body instantly turned into a lightning beam, slamming towards Chu Tianming.
The speed of this lightning was extremely fast, and in an instant, it appeared in front of Chu Tianming.
"Die to me!"
The terrifying purple thunder light lingered on Zixiao Lei Zun's fist, and then he slammed towards Chu Tianming.
This punch was filled with extremely violent power. Even though the power of thunder contained in it could not cause harm to Chu Tianming, Chu Tianming did not dare to underestimate its terrifying power.
Chu Tianming immediately crossed his arms, golden light surged from his body, and a golden shield appeared in front.
Boom!
This punch hit the shield firmly, and the terrifying power of thunder instantly knocked the shield away and hit Chu Tianming's arms heavily.
Huge force came, and Chu Tianming suddenly felt his arms go numb, and his body fell backwards uncontrollably.
After retreating for dozens of miles, they were able to barely resist the huge force.
However, before Chu Tianming could gain a firm foothold, the Zixiao Lei Zun transformed into a bolt of lightning and rushed in front of Chu Tianming again.
"This guy's strength is amazing. Instead of fighting head-on, he is definitely no match for him. It's better to consume the energy in his body first."
Chu Tianming's eyes flashed, his feet stepped into the void, and his figure quickly disappeared on the spot, avoiding Zixiao Lei Zun's attack.
